answer: Each agent's signing key is split into five Shamir shards kept by five random peers, and every epoch the agent must gather three co-signatures to act — a lock no single operator can pick in the nebula of identities. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 colluding shard-holders, and if any three shards sign for two identities the link shows like a canyon in rock, and all five holders lose their stake; honest agents co-sign once per epoch for free. An identity that cannot gather three signatures is frozen until it re-proves custody over three epochs, re-entering via a narrow inlet of fresh audits.
